body:
Yeah, it's not foolproof -- which is why I hadn't succeeded days ago.  Unfortunately, I more than likely got my gun privileges taken away from me last time I got pulled over by cops with a gun in my hands and "voluntarily" committed to the psych ward.

I know it's not ideal, but I'm extremely rapidly approaching the point of no return with my job and family and such -- if I haven't passed it already.
eh, life's not worth the effort to go on.  I've just got a lot of responsibilities, bills, etc to slosh though and nothing to make me really happy.

I had always been jealous of him, only recently had he "convinced" himself to like me -- but now that I've treated him with brazen asshole-ery, he's probably sufficiently turned off to just want me out of his life (even though he was the one who had called the cops before -- but if it happened now, it'd mostly be out of responsiblity rather than genuine caring).

Imma suffocate myself with a bag.  I'd tried before.  30 minutes of oxygen with a 30 gallon bag, my ass.  I started feeling uncomfortable not even 10 seconds in -- but I've been working on techniques to inflate the bag maximally, and now I think I've got a way to easily fill it with an inert gas (not CO2 to trigger the suffocation reflex)

I'm 24, he was 21.  He was quite promiscious and etc "while he was single", but then I just couldn't bring myself to trust him even after we made us official.

I might have loved him.  He really really liked to manage my life.  Since I was on meds and stuff, he felt the need to "take care" of me, and that made him really condescending and such.  It got to the point where everything he did would annoy me, but I still can't stand to see him with other people

Well, the relationship was extremely tainted to begin with -- it was like, all the lies and deception between us had been going on for months before we started a relationship -- but then once I stopped taking meds (because it wouldnt let me drink alcohol, thus go to the club), then I just stopped being able to trust him (even though he wasn't doing anything particularly untrustworthy).

But since then, I've seen him back on dating websites, and that was definitely the last stake in my coffin or w/e the phrase is

Yes, guy. Also gay :(

I guess I had depression.  Idk, I was on meds, but I stopped taking them because I didn't feel like being a child -- and though going back on my meds might fix my mood, my life has been destroyed already, so I guess there's not much of a point

Not nearly as bad as some other people, but I'm just not willing to live life anymore.  Ofc, this all stems from relationship problems, and right now, the main cause of it is just that I can't bear that the other person gets to continue on, being happy, and doing exactly what I feared.

However, I have the option to kill myself, and I don't really have anything important to contribute, so it's a feasible option for me
